# Magic Mouse v3 Windows scroll (PID 0323)

> Kernel research and KMDF filter for Apple Magic Mouse 2024 / Magic Mouse v3 on Windows 10/11. Not Magic Mouse v1/v2. Not Magic Tray (userspace battery app). PATH-A patched applewirelessmouse is not Magic Tray’s KMDF fallback.

- Hardware: Bluetooth PID 0x0323 only.
- Problem: Boot Camp INF has no 0323; HID COL01/COL02 can collapse after DSM (Mode B, scroll gone).
- Magic Tray installs `v2-kmdf-driver/Install-KMDF.cmd` from this repo.
- Battery in the tray is Input 0x90 COL02 (userspace), not this .sys.
- Signing: self-signed / Test Mode until EV + attestation. Fund via https://lesleymurfin.github.io/magic-tray/funding.html (Stripe off GitHub Sponsors).
